name: Cho-Hakkaimon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] For every 2 cards in this Digimon's digivolution cards, activate the following effect:
・1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn.
[Your Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted by having 0 DP, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has ＜Save＞ in its text, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
